selection: minimum DEV_SCORE joint NLL; earliest tie
feasibility_event: finite_xyz AND starts_at_current_state AND tip_segments_clear (includes registered workspace floor)
conditional_loss: BCE(T) over all candidates plus BCE(F) averaged over T=1 candidates; zero conditional term for empty T batch
marginal_loss: BCE(T) plus BCE(F), both over all candidates
joint_control: same two heads/initialization/parameters as factored arms, joint logit=(z0+z1)/sqrt(2), trained by joint BCE
calibration: CALIBRATION only: single/joint positive Platt slope and intercept; factored separate positive temperatures on factor labels (F masked on T for conditional); two parameters each
primary_comparison: conditional versus single and matched-capacity joint, across all 3 generator x 3 scorer seeds
primary_outputs: paired DEV joint Brier/NLL, top1 validity, fixed K4 all-valid and distinct valid modes; natural pools only
evidence_rule: No positive claim from one seed. Report all arms/calibrated and raw scores; at most one diagnosed revision, no DEV coefficient sweep.
candidate_budget: fixed original M8 pools; zero new generator candidates in scorer fitting/evaluation
roles: SCORE_TRAIN fitting, DEV_SCORE checkpoint, CALIBRATION calibration. paired_dev/old_dev/dev32 are reused development only. No TEST_LOCKED access.
